hints.title: Minimal Satisfaction Ordering
hints.text: To maximize the count of satisfied children, smaller greed factors should ideally be satisfied by the smallest possible cookie that suffices.

hints.title: Sorted Dual Index Invariant
hints.text: Sorting both the children greed values and the cookie sizes enables matching the smallest viable cookie to each child in order.

hints.title: Two Pointer Greedy Assignment Procedure
hints.text: Sort the greed factors and cookie sizes in ascending order. Use two pointers to iterate through both arrays. When the current cookie satisfies the current child, advance the child pointer. Always advance the cookie pointer. Return the number of satisfied children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O(N log N + M log M)
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N + M log M) time and O(log N + log M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered matching requires nested loops in O(N * M) time and may waste larger cookies on easily satisfied children.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N log N + M log M) time and O(log N + log M) space, after which a single linear scan assigns cookies optimally.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove why satisfying the smallest greed factor with the smallest sufficient cookie is locally optimal.
